cases.mutation: A spectral observation uses the declared instrument, an unrevoked calibration valid at acquisition, the supported wavelength interval, valid signal quality and a closed composition estimate.
cases.invariant: A composition estimate is admitted only when instrument, calibration, domain, quality, method and composition semantics are coherent.

cases.mutation: Acquire the sample after calibration valid_until_ns.
cases.invariant: An out-of-validity acquisition abstains rather than producing an admitted fibre-composition claim.

cases.mutation: Mark the calibration profile revoked after the spectral acquisition.
cases.invariant: Explicit calibration revocation blocks use of the associated observation.

cases.mutation: Set spectral quality to Saturated while retaining an otherwise valid estimate.
cases.invariant: Saturated sensor channels are not silently normalized into a valid composition.

cases.mutation: The observation wavelength_start_nm is below the declared qualified instrument profile.
cases.invariant: Instrument transfer and wavelength domain must be explicit; a model trained on one range does not automatically qualify another.

cases.mutation: A nominally closed composition includes an explicit non-zero Unknown fibre fraction.
cases.invariant: Known fractions may be retained, but an unresolved component prevents a fully admitted fibre identity.

cases.mutation: Supply a valid visual jacket observation without an NIR spectral observation.
cases.invariant: Visual garment-family recognition cannot produce fibre-composition evidence.

cases.mutation: Pair a visual frame from ITEM-A with a spectral observation from ITEM-B.
cases.invariant: Cross-modal results can only be paired when both observations bind to the same physical item.

cases.mutation: Visual confidence is below the caller-declared minimum confidence threshold.
cases.invariant: Confidence thresholds are a declared policy input and are not silently hard-coded as universal truth.

cases.mutation: The visual model emits an Unknown garment category or Unknown presentation state.
cases.invariant: Out-of-taxonomy and incomplete visual states remain unknown.

cases.mutation: Two TexSortML-style frames with one garment_id are assigned to Train and Test.
cases.invariant: All frames from the same physical garment stay in one split/fold.

cases.mutation: Two NIR spectra with one specimen_id are assigned to Train and Validation.
cases.invariant: Replicate spectra from the same physical specimen stay in one split/fold.

cases.mutation: Nominal fibre fractions sum to 800000 ppm rather than 1000000 ppm.
cases.invariant: Fibre fraction estimates must close to exactly 100% at the declared integer scale.

cases.mutation: Observation instrument_id differs from the instrument profile and calibration identity.
cases.invariant: Results cannot silently transfer across different NIR instruments or calibration profiles.

cases.mutation: All repeated observations for one garment or one NIR specimen remain assigned to the same partition.
cases.invariant: Grouped split integrity permits multiple rows from one physical subject when they remain in one partition.

cases.mutation: Two hyperspectral tiles/patches derived from the same OpenTextile-NIR physical sample are assigned to Train and Test.
cases.invariant: All pixels, tiles, patches, crops and augmentations derived from one physical sample remain in one partition; pixel count is not independent sample count.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic test-intention corpus only. It does not contain real spectra or garment images, implement a fibre classifier, validate a physical sorting line, or qualify recycling, secondary grade, safety or lifecycle benefit.
